correctness.rationale: For nonzero rank-one square-zero operators, commutation implies both products vanish: a common nonzero product would force coincident image lines and then contradict square-zero. Pairwise annihilation yields a UNIQUE shared image span U, each A_i a nonzero rank-one V/U->U map with images spanning U. Gaussian Grassmann count times inclusion-exclusion on nonzero spanning vectors and nonzero covectors modulo (q-1)^r gives exact C_{n,r,d}. The locally trivial rank-one bundle over Gr(d,n) is smooth irreducible dimension r(n-1)+d(n-d). Taking maximal dimensions yields one or two top components depending on n odd and r>=(n+1)/2; lower-dimensional components are NOT classified. Leading powers yield q-asymptotics. Applies all finite fields incl characteristic 2, n>=4,r>=3.
